name: BiliThrottle (哔哩节流阀)
distribution: Unofficial Chrome/Edge MV3 fork; not an upstream extension release

upstream.integration: Applicable runtime backports; MV3 native storage retained, userscript-only adapter changes not applicable

testing.real_mse_synthetic_media_passed: not re-run for 1.2.0 (open-source Chromium lacks H.264); 7 passed on 1.1.0
testing.reason_for_install_e2e_gap: Managed Chromium blocked extension management and live Bilibili pages; not bypassed
testing.installed_extension_focus_e2e_passed: loaded unpacked in Chromium (Playwright chromium-1194) on a routed fixture page: 5-hour window block + reset countdown, play() re-block, snooze, weekly block, automatic lift at window reset, Pomodoro countdown, in-page panel opens
testing.installed_extension_infinite_e2e: loaded unpacked; content-script fetch to api.bilibili.com with page cookies and CORS on a routed homepage: 8 batches over 8 signed requests, no errors; launcher hidden on home, opens on video page
testing.ui_polish_2_3_0_live_bilibili: Loaded unpacked (Playwright Chromium) on live, logged-out bilibili.com: 25-card batches in the 5-column grid, skeleton row always under the newest batch, ⋮ menu and 不感兴趣 blurred/undo state, popup flow-get-state reports current/loaded batches. Watch-later write not exercised (logged out).
testing.theme_detection_live: Live bilibili.com (logged out, unpacked): html.bili_dark toggle on the homepage and bili-theme light->dark stylesheet href swap on a video page both flip the open quick panel; header login popover renders above the panel
testing.ui_polish_round4_live: Live bilibili.com (logged out, unpacked Playwright Chromium): 不感兴趣 swaps the card for a link-free placeholder; middle click + left click on 撤销 opened no tab and restored the same card with href/target; ⋮ menu outside the card; html.bili_dark recorded to storage.local biliTheme and options/popup/welcome opened with data-theme=dark; one click on 完整设置 opened options.html; hovering the header login entry fades the panel to opacity 0 and back. Fixture test simulates B 站 delegated window.open listeners registered before the content script.
testing.ui_polish_round5_live: Live bilibili.com (logged out, unpacked): 不感兴趣 placeholder (blurred cover, 已减少此类推荐, 撤销, ×, 知道了) still present 6.6 s later with the pointer away, dismissed after the 8 s minimum; on a live video page Alt+T alternately opened and closed the panel, including with focus inside the panel; the panel top stayed ≥64px.
testing.playback_investigation_round5: BV1cNd8BoEoW, logged out, Playwright Chromium + unpacked extension. Player code identical to origin/main except version strings. curl from the box: uncached upos ranges 24-102 KB/s on cosov (TTFB 4-11 s), akam 0.065-2 MB/s. Unthrottled 90 s: branch/main/no-extension all play (35-72 s buffered), no freeze (heartbeat lag <0.3 s). 400 kbps: branch and main both black ~65 s (takeover, fetch failure, auto-retake); no extension starts at ~76 s. With the new 20 s slow-start guard: takeover at ~43 s, handed back at ~63 s, no retake, native playing from ~93 s, 110 media requests instead of 169-179.

proxy_feature: removed in 2.3.0 (Chrome rejects proxy as an optional permission)
